BiblicalUsage: Ragan is to grumble, to murmur in rebellion. Israel murmured in their tents, saying, 'Because the LORD hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt'; the psalm says they 'murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD'; and Isaiah promises that 'they that murmured shall learn doctrine.'
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that murmuring is unbelief with its voice lowered: Israel grumbled in the tents where no one could hear but God — and He heard.
